title: Empty state
description: What an empty list or page shows. `first-use`: one icon, one sentence, the one primary action that fills it. `no-results`: a search or filter matched nothing, with its own title and a “Xoá lọc” action.
when: First use: no items yet, a feature not set up (variant first-use).
A search or filter matched nothing (variant no-results, with onClearFilters).
a11y: The action is a normal button; below sm the state takes at most 40% of the viewport.

examples.title: First use
examples.description: One icon, one sentence, one primary action.

examples.title: No results
examples.description: A filter matched nothing: different title, “Xoá lọc” clears it.

instead.need: The page or the data failed to load
A wrong URL or a page the user cannot open

instead.use: Skeleton in the shape of the content

notes: When the list is empty and the state shows its own primary action, hide the primary button in the page's title row (one filled button per view, §13).
Keep the title and toolbar on screen around a no-results state: the user must be able to change the filter.
